mechanism: Both drugs inhibit cardiac potassium channels (hERG); moxifloxacin is a known QT-prolonging fluoroquinolone and oxybutynin has anticholinergic properties that can affect cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; use with caution in patients with cardiac risk factors, electrolyte abnormalities, or baseline QT prolongation; consider alternative antimicrobial if possible.
